title: GB300 native Windows ARM64 OpenShell MXC qualification

decisions.model_rationale: OpenShell provides the MXC sandbox and governed transport; it does not select or ship local-inference models. Product Management and the agent-app owner may attach optional model evidence without replacing an OpenShell/MXC gate.
decisions.nemoclaw_credit: Native-x64 NemoClaw qualification is a separate gate and cannot satisfy native Windows ARM64 OpenShell/MXC coverage.

openshell_dev.name: Shailendra Singh
openshell_dev.responsibility: OpenShell MXC implementation, build, and repository-owned tests

gb300_qa.name: Rohit Varma Kalidindi
gb300_qa.responsibility: GB300 host execution, evidence custody, and release verdict

sw_program.name: Eric Tam
sw_program.responsibility: Cross-team schedule and unresolved dependency coordination

agent_app.name: Agent application owner
agent_app.responsibility: Versioned ARM64 application/runtime inputs and application-level acceptance

mxc_platform.name: MXC platform owner
mxc_platform.responsibility: GB300 wxc-exec build, enabled backend, and platform prerequisites

matrix.title: Qualification contract integrity
prerequisites: Repository checkout containing this manifest and validator
pass_criteria: Validator exits 0
Every matrix row has a valid disposition, owner, prerequisites, pass criteria, and artifact contract
Required ARM64 rows are non-skippable and x64-only rows cannot receive ARM64 credit

matrix.title: Exact windows-tip source provenance
prerequisites: Fresh fetch of the NVIDIA/OpenShell origin remote
Expected base SHA recorded before qualification
Clean worktree based directly on that origin/windows SHA
pass_criteria: Fetched origin/windows equals the expected 40-character base SHA
HEAD descends directly from that base SHA
The worktree is clean before evidence collection

matrix.title: Native GB300 Windows ARM64 host and MXC preflight
prerequisites: Elevated PowerShell for MXC loopback and AppContainer setup
pass_criteria: Host OS is Windows and RuntimeInformation.OSArchitecture is Arm64
Execution is not WSL or emulation
Operator hardware attestation identifies GB300
wxc-exec PE machine is ARM64
Probe verdicts processcontainer=live and dryRun=ok

matrix.title: ARM64 MSVC workspace check
prerequisites: Visual Studio ARM64 compiler, Spectre libraries, Clang, CMake, and Windows SDK
pass_criteria: Command exits 0
Windows-supported workspace and gateway dependency-boundary check both pass

matrix.title: ARM64 release artifacts
prerequisites: Pinned prebuilt Z3 runtime or a complete approved override
pass_criteria: Release build exits 0
openshell-gateway.exe, openshell.exe, openshell-supervisor-relay.exe, and libz3.dll exist for aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
Size and SHA256 are recorded for every artifact

matrix.title: Native ARM64 Windows workspace tests
pass_criteria: Command exits 0
The CI nextest profile and server test-support suite pass natively

matrix.title: Unsupported Windows compute-driver boundaries
pass_criteria: Focused unsupported-driver tests exit 0
Protocol-only, MXC-only, Docker-stub-only, and MXC-plus-Docker-stub compositions pass

matrix.title: Strict live ProcessContainer integration
prerequisites: Network path to the allowlisted HTTPS fixture
pass_criteria: Every required dry-run and ProcessContainer test passes
No required test emits SKIP
In-policy write succeeds, out-of-policy write is denied, and governed HTTPS reads the injected CA bundle

matrix.title: Tier-3 ProcessContainer policy scenarios
prerequisites: Fresh ARM64 gateway, CLI, relay, and Z3 artifacts staged with tracked fixtures
pass_criteria: fs-rw, fs-readonly, fs-default-deny, and network-reject all PASS
Summary is PASS=4 FAIL=0 SKIP=0
The exact rendered TOML, policies, gateway logs, transcript, and summary are retained

matrix.title: OpenClaw ARM64 MXC launch and dynamic forwarding
prerequisites: Allowed HTTPS endpoint available to the governed-egress proof
pass_criteria: node.exe PE machine is ARM64
OpenClaw package version is captured
Sandbox reaches ready and the authenticated host-side OpenClaw client returns ok=true through openshell forward service
Allowed HTTPS succeeds while denied host and direct Internet bypass remain blocked

matrix.title: MXC isolation_session backend
prerequisites: IsoSessionApp.dll and isolation_session support in wxc-exec
pass_criteria: If executed, provision-start-exec-stop-deprovision completes and cleanup leaves no orphan
Absence is recorded with the probe reason and does not fail the GB300 ProcessContainer gate

matrix.title: MXC provider credential substitution
pass_criteria: If executed, placeholder substitution succeeds only at the bound endpoint
No credential or bearer value appears in retained artifacts

matrix.title: MXC ETW to OCSF audit
pass_criteria: If executed, events are attributed to the owned sandbox and secret-free OCSF JSONL is retained

matrix.title: Agent-app local inference models
pass_criteria: No model is implicitly claimed by the OpenShell contract
If supplied, optional evidence records exact model ID, model hash or version, inference runtime, prompt outcome, and latency

matrix.title: Agent applications other than OpenClaw
pass_criteria: Applications are added explicitly rather than inferred from generic OpenShell coverage
Optional app evidence cannot replace the required OpenClaw or MXC rows

matrix.title: WSL execution
pass_criteria: No WSL result is accepted as native WoA evidence
matrix.reason: NVBug 6643699 explicitly scopes GB300 coverage to native Windows-on-Arm and states WSL: No.

matrix.title: Docker, Kubernetes, Podman, and VM compute drivers on Windows
pass_criteria: Focused rejection contracts pass; no unsupported driver is presented as GB300 runtime coverage
matrix.reason: The Windows gateway retains explicit unsupported stubs; only the in-process MXC compute driver is a native Windows runtime.

matrix.title: Portable process policy enforcement in MXC
pass_criteria: Explicit process policy is rejected rather than silently weakened
matrix.reason: MXC supplies OS isolation but has no supported mapping for OpenShell portable process policy.

matrix.title: GPU passthrough through the MXC driver
pass_criteria: No GPU passthrough claim is made from host GPU presence
matrix.reason: GPU passthrough is not pursued by the host-side-governance MXC design.

matrix.title: Interactive exec and connect
pass_criteria: Dynamic service forwarding is tested without claiming interactive exec/connect support
matrix.reason: The supervisor relay supports launch, shutdown, and dynamic forwarding but not the Linux ConnectSupervisor protocol.

matrix.title: NemoClaw native-x64 qualification
prerequisites: Native x64 host required by the NemoClaw qualification guard
pass_criteria: Run only in the separately owned native-x64 lane
Never use its result to satisfy a GB300 Windows ARM64 row
matrix.reason: The current NemoClaw qualification guard requires native x64; this contract qualifies OpenShell/MXC on native ARM64 independently.

matrix.title: Bundled win-x64 Node.js installer helper
pass_criteria: The helper remains usable for x64 development
GB300 qualification instead supplies an independently versioned ARM64 node.exe and verifies its PE machine
matrix.reason: The helper downloads node-v<version>-win-x64.zip and therefore cannot establish native ARM64 application coverage.

matrix.title: Windows x64 build and test lanes
pass_criteria: Results remain x64 regression evidence only
Cross-builds and emulated execution cannot satisfy native ARM64 rows
matrix.reason: GB300 WoA qualification requires native ARM64 execution.
